\[
U = -\frac{G M m}{R}

\[

\]

\[
\Delta U = G M^2 \left( \frac{1}{R_i} - \frac{1}{R_f} \right)
\]

\[
\Delta U = G M^2 \left( \frac{1}{R_i} - \frac{2}{R_i} \right) = -\frac{G M^2}{R_i}
\]

The negative sign indicates energy release. The energy released is also equal to the integral of the luminosity over time:

\[
\Delta U = \int_{0}^{t} P \, dt = \int_{0}^{t} 4 \pi R^2 \sigma T_0^4 \, dt
\]
